name: Advanced Custom Fields Pro
couldBuild: Field groups, location rules, a repeater and a flexible-content field over post meta, plus the get_field() helpers your templates call.
stillMissing: Very little, and that is the point — ACF Pro is close to pure code. What you would actually be taking on is a decade of edge cases in serialisation, block and Gutenberg integration, and the fact that every theme and plugin you own already calls its API. Rebuilding it is easy; migrating off it is not.
requirements: Field-group UI with conditional logic and location rules
Repeater and flexible-content fields with nested sub-fields
Options pages and per-field-group settings storage
A stable read API (get_field/the_field) your templates can call
Block registration so fields drive Gutenberg blocks

alternatives.name: Advanced Custom Fields (free)
alternatives.desc: Everything except repeater, flexible content, options pages and blocks.

alternatives.name: Meta Box
alternatives.desc: A code-first custom fields framework with a generous free core.

alternatives.name: Carbon Fields
alternatives.desc: Developer-oriented fields declared entirely in PHP, no UI to maintain.

notes: The lowest moat in the index for a reason: almost all of the value is code you can read. The lock-in is switching cost, not vendor dependency.
